'''Nol''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Myykian]] who lived on [[At Attin]] during the [[New Republic Era]] with their partner [[Nooma]] and four children—[[Neel]], [[Tuloo]], and [[twin]] boys [[Jobo]] and [[Jorko]].<ref name="Real Adventure" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nol first appeared in "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]]," the first episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="Real Adventure" /> which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref> The character performance was done by [[Carey Jones]].<ref name="Real Adventure" />
